title: From the contest floor to the field: four days in Sichuan
summary: The team went 2400 metres into the mountain at the China Jinping Underground Laboratory, compared training methods with the cluster team at Southwest Petroleum University, and visited the Chengdu Aircraft Industrial Group.

title: A joint salon with the GRID satellite team
summary: A morning on where high performance computing, AI and space astronomy meet: neutrino event reconstruction, cluster support for parallel AI inference, and an agent that automates gamma-ray burst analysis. Open to undergraduates from any background.
